name: Curve-Skeleton Decomposition
definition: A proxy geometry used to achieve bend, move/re-pose, and sweep effects, defined as a 1D line-like representation of the object (sometimes referred to as a centerline) that captures the essential topology of an object.
summary: Curve-Skeleton Decomposition represents volumetric objects as 1D skeletons to enable fast, interactive manipulation by decomposing volumes into independently transformable bounding cuboids.
